feeding_claim.verbatim: Our poultry is humanely raised and rotated on fresh pasture daily

notes: New Haven County farm on leased land, run by Chris Wellington and Kirsten Marra; mailing address is in Meriden. Checked the homepage, about, contact, meat chickens, eggs, pork and ordering pages. Meat chickens go to pasture in portable shelters at 4 weeks and are moved daily, with non-GMO grain supplement; laying hens are on pasture in warm months and in high tunnels in winter; pigs are on 2 to 3 acres of pasture and forest but are fed non-GMO grain and garden scraps. Category pastured. Whole birds picked up at the farm; birds and cuts sold at the Stamford Farmers' Market in season; eggs on the farm year round. Pork sold only by the half or whole pig; pork sold out for 2026 and poultry shares closed until orders open in January 2027. Eggs page also says eggs can be ordered through HealthyPlanEat. Second phone (860) 805-0788. Also grows vegetables. Verifier: the quote may continue with 'to keep the birds healthy...' on the page; confirm wording.
